title: Sticky bomb

fields.label: Function
fields.value: Explodes damaging trees and ores, sticks to surfaces

body:
"Wait, if it's a sticky bomb how doesn't it get stuck to your hand?"

The Sticky Bomb is a special explosive sold exclusively at the River Shop for 1 Credit. It is a throwable bomb that sticks to surfaces.

Details

The Sticky Bomb, unlike any other explosive, can be picked up and treated like a tool that the player can hold in their inventory. While equipped, the user can throw it, which will cause it to stick to the first surface it impacts. On the ground, it can still be ignited as if it were any other explosive.

Regardless of the method of activation, the Sticky Bomb explodes like a regular Small Bomb.

Trivia

  • A gimmick of the Sticky Bomb is "sticky jumping" using vehicles. It has grown popular enough that the developers started a contest incentivizing people to "trickshot" with their sticky jumps. The winner of the contest will earn 6,000 Robux.
  • A patch on 4 March, 2024 fixed an issue where "property flinging" could occur.
